about.title: About WhitePact
about.heading: Autonomy needs an enforceable pact
about.description: Why WhitePact exists: to keep autonomous action inside explicit human authority.
sections: Doctrine
The agent may think freely. It may plan freely. But it cannot act outside independently enforced authority.
Operating principle
Evidence before assertion. Implemented repository controls, deployed behavior and external assurance are separate claims.

docs.title: Developer Documentation | WhitePact
docs.heading: Route supported actions through a governed boundary
docs.description: Connect supported API and MCP actions to WhitePact's configured governance boundary.
sections: Local setup

Clone https://github.com/Guruprasath-Annadurai/Whitepact.git, check out 52d9b3c5497af24bb7d4a7147e33deaadc64296e, run pip install -e ".[dashboard]" in that checkout, then start uvicorn responsibleai.dashboard.app:app on localhost. The published distribution was 1.2.6 when checked on 2026-10-04 and may differ from this source baseline. Follow database, encryption and authority prerequisites before consequential testing.
Authentication is not authority
Bearer credentials authenticate requests but do not establish root legitimacy, consent or execution authority.
Result handling
Approval required is pending, denial is not success, and UNKNOWN means the downstream effect is uncertain. Do not retry UNKNOWN automatically.
Interfaces

POST /api/v1/governance/tools/call requires an organization-scoped API key authorized for at least the ANALYST role and a supported tool. Use deployed /mcp for compatible Streamable HTTP clients. Bearer integrations list evidence at GET /api/governance/evidence; GET /api/web/evidence/EVIDENCE_ID requires an authenticated browser session and organization membership. Baseline SDK evidence-detail helpers reference an unavailable route. Review exact deployed schemas at /api/docs.

trust.title: Trust Center | WhitePact
trust.heading: Controls, evidence and honest boundaries
trust.description: WhitePact security architecture, assurance status and known limitations.
sections: Controls
Evaluate implemented controls against the exact release, deployed configuration and supported enforcement path.
Evidence boundary
Hash-chained evidence has documented verification boundaries. It does not independently confirm every external effect.
Assurance status
SOC 2: not currently certified. ISO 27001: not currently certified. Independent commercial penetration test is not currently claimed.
Known limitations
Hosted production, legal and independent assurance gates are separate. Same-process trusted code is outside universal non-bypassability claims.

sovereign.title: WhitePact Sovereign | Authority analysis workbench
sovereign.heading: See authority before it becomes action
sovereign.description: Inspect configured authority relationships and supporting evidence with WhitePact Sovereign.
sections: Analysis, not authority
The authenticated Workbench displays canonical Core output. Manifest expectations and development previews are not execution authority.
Availability
Features depend on deployed contract, authenticated tenant context and configuration. Missing data must remain unavailable, not become a fixture fallback.
